1 SCOPE
This standard lays down general instructions for the gui dance of an author for the preparation of the text of an article communicating the results of research to a learned periodical.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which. through reference in this text. consti tute provi sion of this standard. At the time of publication. the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revi sion and parties to agreements based on thi s standard arc encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed in Annex A.
